resources.string: Remove HyperOS\'s restrictions on FCM connection-related broadcasts. System power consumption may increase when this module is enabled.

Only apps with detectable Firebase/GCM integration are shown by default. Checked apps may be woken / auto-started when an FCM push arrives. Detection is heuristic, so you can show all apps for manual overrides.
Installed-apps access was denied. HyperOS may only expose a partial app list.
